title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Theater on 1969-07-05

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with noticeable mud and hiss, but a high‑energy 1969 show highlighted by an epic Dark Star and marathon Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as an “effin great” night with standout moments like Dark Star, St. Stephen, China Cat Sunflower > High Time, and a 35‑minute Lovelight that keep the energy high. The soundboard source suffers from muddy mids, tape hiss and occasional wobble – especially on Baby Blue – but most listeners consider it acceptable for a 1969 capture.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars for musical excitement, while recording issues keep the overall average around the mid‑3 range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy mids, prominent tape hiss, occasional wobble and distortion (notably on Baby Blue). Some reviewers note a decent stereo mix for the era but overall clarity is limited.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening couple of songs, a few shaky spots in the middle, then a soaring second half culminating in an extended Lovelight closer.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Raw power on Dark Star; some reviewers note he flubs phrases in St. Stephen and The Eleven.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s vocals and organ drive the set, especially on Hard To Handle and Turn On Your Love Light.
